quote: We cannot control what other nations do. We can control what we give ourselves — what we build for ourselves.
name: Mark Carney

quote: For years we have been buying significantly from foreign suppliers for short-term gain. Now, we need to use government procurement, using Canadian taxpayer dollars, to spur Canadian businesses for longer-term prosperity.
name: Mark Carney

quote: Being our own best customer will put more of every public dollar back into our economy, creating Canadian careers, using Canadian resources, and benefiting Canadian communities.
name: Mark Carney

quote: The analogy I like to use is you can’t make a Swiss watch in China. People know Canada for the cold. This is a quintessentially Canadian product. And we had decades of manufacturing expertise here.
name: Dani Reiss

quote: The trend going forward is about finding your niche or mass customization… Becoming the best at what you can do. People are willing to pay more money for that.
name: Jeff Brownlee

quote: If it’s made in Canada, you can trust it was made well. That’s part of our brand.
name: Justin Trudeau

quote: It’s time we started training people once again for the real economy — the economy where people get their hands dirty making and building things.
name: Frank Stronach

quote: I fight for Canadian companies and Canadian workers.
name: Barry Zekelman
